rows.ARS:
Mauve or mauve blend Floribunda.
Registration name: WEKstameda
Exhibition name: Love Song
rows.Origin:
Bred by Tom Carruth (United States, before 2009).
Introduced in United States by Weeks Wholesale Rose Grower, Inc. in 2011 as 'Love Song'.
rows.Bloom: Lavender. None to mild, citrus fragrance. 50 to 65 petals. Average diameter 3.25". Medium to large, very full (41+ petals), in small clusters, high-centered to cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Ovoid, rounded buds.
rows.Habit:
Medium, bushy, rounded, upright. Large, matte, medium green foliage. 3 to 5 leaflets.

Height: 4¼' to 4'11" (130 to 150cm). Width: 28" to 35" (70 to 90cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 5b and warmer. Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden.
rows.Patents:
United States - Patent No: PP 24,743 on 12 Aug 2014 VIEW USPTO PATENT
Application No: 13/694,324 on 19 Nov 2012
Inventors: Carruth; Thomas F. (Altadena, CA)

This invention relates to a new and distinct variety of Floribunda Rose. It has an undisseminated seedling of my creation as its seed parent with the following genetic origin {Stainless Steel×(Blueberry Hill×Stephen's Big Purple)}×Sunset Celebration and as its pollen parent the variety known as ‘WEKblunez’ (U.S. Plant Pat. No. 16,572)...The branches used for the photograph came from 3 to 4 year-old rose plants of the new variety grown outdoors in Pomona, Calif. in the month of September.
